description: Search the BLS series catalog by natural language query, survey code, geographic area, or keywords to resolve cryptic SeriesIDs. Returns matching series with decoded components (survey, area, item, seasonal flag, and publication frequency for surveys that publish one series at several frequencies) and plain-language names, ranked by relevance and paged with limit and offset. Use this before bls_get_series when you have a concept but not a SeriesID. Operates offline against an index of the major surveys — no API quota consumed. Survey filter accepts the two-letter code of an indexed survey (CU, AP, CE, LN, LA, PC, WP, JT, EC, PR, MP, CW, CM, CI, SM, LE, EI, SU, IP, BD, LU, EE; OE is indexed only when the server sets BLS_CATALOG_INCLUDE_OES=true, and otherwise composes OEWS SeriesIDs from the OE code tables, marked composed and unconfirmed); series in other surveys are fetched by SeriesID with bls_get_series. Area filter accepts place names, USPS state codes, and FIPS, CBSA, and CPI area codes.

area.description: Geographic area to narrow results to, case-insensitive. A USPS state code (TX) or 2-digit state FIPS code (48) selects the state: its statewide series, the areas in it (metro areas reaching into it included), and series with no decoded area whose title names it. An all-digit area code selects the area it names in every survey that decodes it: 3 digits a combined statistical area (CSA), 4 a CPI area (0000 is the U.S. city average), 5 a county FIPS or metro area (CBSA) code, 7 a city or town (state + place FIPS); a code naming no indexed area returns no series. Any other value, such as a place name ("Seattle") or a SeriesID fragment ("ST48"), matches as a substring of the area name, title, or SeriesID; another all-digit value does too, with a notice. Under survey OE with no indexed OE rows, area selects the OEWS areas to compose: a USPS state code or 2-digit state FIPS names the state, a 5-digit CBSA or 7-digit OEWS area code (0042660, 5300000) its area, and any other value is a substring of an OEWS area name; each metro or state it names also composes its state and national rows. Without this filter, a place query names in full (every distinctive word of it, e.g. "black hawk") ranks first among the series matching every query word; otherwise, among equal matches, current series rank first, then national ones.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10); requests above 50 are clamped to 50 with notice.

offset.description: Number of ranked results to skip, for paging past the first page (default 0). Pass nextOffset from the previous response to get the next page.

query.description: Natural language or keyword query (e.g. "unemployment rate", "CPI food", "nonfarm payrolls"). Also accepts a SeriesID directly for exact lookup.

seasonal_adjustment.description: When true, return only seasonally adjusted series. When false, return only not-seasonally-adjusted. Omit to return both.

survey.description: Two-letter LABSTAT survey abbreviation to filter results, case-insensitive (e.g. CU for CPI, CE for CES, SM for state and metro CES, LN for CPS, LA for LAUS, JT for JOLTS). Indexed surveys: CU, AP, CE, LN, LA, PC, WP, JT, EC, PR, MP, CW, CM, CI, SM, LE, EI, SU, IP, BD, LU, EE; OE (OEWS) is indexed only when the server sets BLS_CATALOG_INCLUDE_OES=true, and without its rows OE composes OEWS SeriesIDs from the OE code tables for the occupation, place, and data type the query and area name, each marked composed. Omit to search all indexed surveys.

name: bls_search_series

areaFilter.description: Area filter applied, trimmed. Absent when no area filter was passed or it was blank.

cap.description: The result limit that capped the returned list.

capped.description: True when the FTS candidate pool, after the survey/area/seasonal filters, reached the internal cap (~1000), or when composing OEWS SeriesIDs stopped at its 50-row cap with combinations left. totalCount is then a lower bound and offset paging stops at the pool. Narrow the query, add filters, or use a direct SeriesID to get an exact count.

catalogSize.description: Total series in the loaded catalog index. Distinguishes an empty-result search from a failed catalog load.

effectiveQuery.description: Query string as the server received and searched on. Confirms interpretation for self-correction.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `catalog_loading`: The catalog index holds no series yet and a LABSTAT harvest is building it — at first startup, or while an hourly check retries an empty index. `catalog_unavailable`: The catalog index holds no series and no harvest is running — every LABSTAT download failed, or the load stopped with an error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitApplied.description: Result limit in effect (defaults to 10 when omitted).

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page. Present only when truncated is true.

notice.description: Requested and applied limits when clamped, and how an all-digit area that is not an area code matched, plus guidance on unindexed surveys, offsets past the end, empty results, the next page, the capped candidate pool, or composed OEWS SeriesIDs, which stay unconfirmed until bls_get_series returns them. Absent when neither applies and this page ends an uncapped list of indexed series.

offsetApplied.description: Offset in effect (defaults to 0 when omitted).

seasonalFilter.description: Seasonal-adjustment filter applied, if any. Absent when not passed.

composed.description: True when the SeriesID was composed from the OEWS code tables rather than read from the index: unconfirmed until bls_get_series returns data for it, since BLS leaves many occupation–area cells unpublished. Composed rows carry no coverage years. Absent for indexed series.

endPeriod.description: Last observation period code in the catalog snapshot, when available (e.g. M08 or Q04).

endYear.description: Last observation year in the catalog snapshot, when available.

frequency.description: Publication frequency — "Monthly", "Semi-Annual", "Quarterly", or "Annual" — for CU, CW, LN, and BD, which publish one series at several frequencies under the same title. Absent for other surveys.

item.description: Item or subject name, when decoded.

seasonal.description: Seasonality descriptor matching the data-tool form: "Seasonally Adjusted" or "Not Seasonally Adjusted".

seriesId.description: BLS SeriesID — pass to bls_get_series or bls_get_latest to fetch data.

startYear.description: First observation year in the catalog snapshot, when available; does not imply continuous coverage.

shown.description: Number of series returned in this response.

surveyFilter.description: Survey filter applied, trimmed and uppercased. Absent when no survey filter was passed or it was blank.

totalCount.description: Total ranked results after every filter (area included), before limit and offset. A lower bound when capped is true — the catalog index may contain more matching series.

truncated.description: True when ranked results remain past this page; nextOffset fetches them.

title: Search BLS Series
